summary: Completed backend testing of holiday feature for lottery system. All 17 tests passed. Verified: POST /api/lotteries/{id}/holidays for closed and special hours holidays, GET /api/lotteries/{id}/holidays, DELETE /api/lotteries/{id}/holidays/{date}, GET /api/lotteries returns is_holiday and holiday_name fields, check_lottery_open returns correct closed_message on holidays.

minor.issue: When today is a holiday with special hours (e.g., open: 10:00, close: 18:00), and current time is after closing, the 'tomorrow' message incorrectly uses the holiday's opening time (10:00) instead of normal hours (08:00). Affects closed_message when today is special-hours holiday and tomorrow is NOT a holiday.
minor.line: server.py:464 - opening_time variable is set from holiday's special hours instead of lottery's normal opening_time

action_items: Fix check_lottery_open() to save original opening_time before checking holidays, and use that for tomorrow's message when tomorrow is not a holiday
critical_code_review_comments: check_lottery_open() correctly handles closed holidays (closed: true) with message '🎉 Cerrada por {holiday_name}'
check_lottery_open() correctly handles special hours holidays and shows holiday name in today_hours
GET /api/lotteries correctly returns is_holiday and holiday_name fields computed from check_lottery_open
Minor bug: When today is special-hours holiday, tomorrow's message uses holiday's hours instead of normal hours (line 464)
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed lotteries with holidays for testing. Known lottery 31fe9898-c280-4eb3-82be-9a2b6adb9a62 has Navidad 2026-12-25 configured.

rca_of_issue: Minor bug in check_lottery_open (server.py line 464): When today is a holiday with special hours, the variable 'opening_time' gets set to holiday's open time at line 407. Later when generating tomorrow's message (line 464), this modified 'opening_time' is used instead of the lottery's original opening_time. Fix: Save lottery's original opening_time before holiday checking and use that for non-holiday tomorrow messages.
